ev.q: This report summarizes evidence considered by ACIP in recommending 9vHPV
Efficacy for prevention of ≥CIN2 caused by HPV 31, 33, 45, 52, or 58 was 96.3%
The Advisory Committee on Immunization Practices (ACIP) recommends routine HPV vaccination at age 11 or 12 years
Evidence supporting 9vHPV use was evaluated using the Grading of Recommendations, Assessment, Development, and Evaluation (GRADE) framework

methods_quotes.q: the ACIP HPV Vaccine Work Group reviewed clinical trial data assessing the efficacy, immunogenicity, and safety of 9vHPV
Evidence supporting 9vHPV use was evaluated using the Grading of Recommendations, Assessment, Development, and Evaluation (GRADE) framework
Females who received all 3 vaccinations within 1 year of enrollment, did not have major deviations from the study protocol
